API_ID.description: Telegram API ID, available at https://my.telegram.org. Required to connect the bot to Telegram servers.

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash, available at https://my.telegram.org. Required alongside API ID.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot Token from BotFather after creating your Telegram bot.

MONGO_DB_URI.description: MongoDB database connection URI, used for storing user and bot-related data. Get it from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

OWNER_ID.description: DausaXmusic owner's numeric Telegram user ID.

STRING_SESSION.description: Authorized Kurigram/Pyrogram session string generated locally for your assistant account; never use an untrusted session-generator website.

LOGGER_ID.description: Chat ID of your log group where the bot sends important logs. Make sure the bot is admin in that group.

COOKIE_URL.description: Optional private HTTPS URL for your own authorized Netscape YouTube cookie export. Leave blank for anonymous playback; never use a public paste.

QUEUE_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of tracks allowed in one chat queue, including the currently playing track.

PLAYLIST_FETCH_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of tracks imported from one playlist request.

YTPROXY_URL.description: (Optional) Base URL for your authorized xBit-compatible media fallback; leave blank for direct yt-dlp.

YT_API_KEY.description: (Optional) API key associated with your primary xBit music API endpoint.

WORKER_FALLBACK_API_ATTEMPTS.description: Worker API attempts for transient 429/5xx failures.

WORKER_FALLBACK_API_RETRY_DELAY_MS.description: Base delay between transient Worker API retries, in milliseconds.

YOUTUBE_STREAM_HTTP_PROBE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds to wait for the first byte from a direct yt-dlp or authorized Worker media stream.

YOUTUBE_STREAM_PREFLIGHT.description: Set 1 to validate direct/Worker audio with FFmpeg before playback; recommended default.

YOUTUBE_STREAM_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds allowed for direct/Worker stream audio validation.

DEEP_API.description: (Optional) DeepAI API key for enabling AI-powered features. Get it from https://deepai.org/.

VOICEPLAY_GROQ_API_KEY.description: Primary free-tier Groq key for reliable multilingual Voice Play recognition. Keep it private.

VOICEPLAY_GROQ_API_KEY2.description: Optional authorized backup Groq key. Used automatically if the primary key is temporarily rate-limited or unavailable.

VOICEPLAY_GROQ_API_KEYS.description: Optional comma-separated pool of additional authorized Groq keys for round-robin failover.

VOICEPLAY_STT_MODEL.description: Groq multilingual speech-to-text model used by Voice Play.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Your Heroku account API key, required if you want the bot to support auto-updates or dynamic deployments.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: The name of your Heroku app. Required if using HEROKU_API_KEY for deployments.

WORKER_FALLBACK_API_URL.description: Optional base URL for your own authorized Worker media fallback; upstream credentials are not included.

WORKER_FALLBACK_API_KEY.description: Optional key for your authorized media API provider.

PHONE_LOOKUP_API_KEY.description: Optional key for phone lookup integration.
